about_the_game:
Reality is glitching. Survival is code.

A hyper-intelligent computer virus has torn through the digital veil, bleeding into our world and twisting the very fabric of reality. In 404 Breakpoint, you're thrust into a terrifying new era where the familiar has become alien, and the digital nightmare is chillingly tangible. Navigate through the digital world that looks like ours.

Complete puzzles and find keys to discover the entity that started this apocalypse, get warped to the digital and play as James Mintz, the World Middleweight Boxing Champion and confront the entity. Every creaking floorboard, every flicker of corrupted light could draw the attention of the digital plague's horrifying manifestations. Direct confrontation is often suicide; your survival hinges on your ability to remain unseen, unheard.

 

Master the Art of Evasion: Stealth is your ultimate weapon., utilize lockers to hide yourself, and stay away from the entities.

A World Unplugged: Discover the world that the entity has made for us, using real world materials and objects used to scare the protagonist.

Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in a chilling soundscape and visually unsettling environments that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

short_description: A terrifying virus has breached our reality. In 404 Breakpoint, you're not fighting zombies or monsters—you're battling a digital plague that twists the world around you. Navigate through the digital world made for you, the protagonist and rely on stealth to survive against the digital virus.
